entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that serves as a universal memory layer for AI agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states and is available as an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and sub-300ms recall. It automates fact extraction and user profile maintenance while supporting multi-modal extractors for various file types.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that unifies agent memories and skills using a filesystem management paradigm. It utilizes tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to reduce token consumption and supports directory recursive retrieval.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: A brain for the Hermes Agent that provides synthesis and gap analysis for queried data. It utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges and supports both local PGLite and remote server deployments.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is available via Python and Node.js client SDKs and offers Docker-based deployment options.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using Git-like version control. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency, sub-millisecond memory system that uses a SQLite backend. It is compatible with MCP clients and includes a TripleStore for temporal knowledge graph management.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and playbooks. It supports Python and TypeScript surfaces and includes MCP server capabilities.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite-backed message store with FTS metadata. It builds a depth-aware summary DAG to provide compacted history for the agent.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend that enables private cross-session memory for the Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes automated setup for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer that stores memory as plain-text YAML engrams on a local disk. It supports hierarchical scoping for global and project-specific knowledge across multiple agent systems.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first layer for managing identity, memory, and secrets that allows for portable state across multiple agent harnesses. It includes a dedicated dashboard for inspecting and repairing memory.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device, local-first context engine that uses hybrid retrieval with BM25 and vector search. It integrates via MCP and plugins and captures decisions using a local GGUF observer model.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: An optimization plugin that reduces prefill latency and token consumption through block reordering and deduplication. It is natively compatible with the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search. It is a local-first architecture that avoids the use of vector databases or embeddings.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: A self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable recall with scoring reasons for every result. It includes contradiction tracking and a self-directing loop to identify knowledge gaps.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by watching agent session logs. It uses local-first storage via SQLite-vec and GGUF models.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system featuring semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It provides automated indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A tool to reduce prompt token overhead by using local BM25 tool ranking for keyword selection. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard for tracking token savings.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: A memory and context layer that resolves live workspace state into verified facts at tool invocation time. It implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) via stdio or SSE.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: A long-term, cross-project memory system that stores data as canonical Markdown files with wikilink support. It operates locally without a required daemon or external database.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin that uses a columnar.lbdb embedded graph database. It features importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports real, immediate event deletion. It provides an audit trace of prefetch operations via a trace.jsonl log.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A memory provider that enables cross-agent recall through semantic search and provenance tracking. It supports durable state storage with session snapshots and TTL.
entries.piprail/piprail: An SDK and MCP server that enables AI agents to pay for API usage using various blockchain families. It integrates with Hermes and OpenClaw.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A memory plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools for searching and manually storing specific memories.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: A plugin providing private local code memory for repositories via semantic search and file reads. It requires a local SourceVault server for functionality.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: A memory provider featuring 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It uses hybrid search methods and provides automatic context checkpointing.

entries.obra/superpowers: An agentic skills framework and software development methodology utilizing a subagent-driven-development process. It includes skills for brainstorming and planning while emphasizing red/green TDD and YAGNI.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first open-source design and prototyping system that supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports. It is compatible with various coding agents and OpenAI-compatible endpoints, including Hermes Agent.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A collection of 817 production-grade cybersecurity skills mapped to six major frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. These skills cover 29 security domains and are compatible with Hermes Agent.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: A tool that generates editable.drawio files from natural language descriptions or Mermaid text. It supports 11 diagram type presets and includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: An auditing and rewriting tool designed to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns using a 111-entry word replacement table. It is compatible with Hermes and supports a two-pass detection system.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that provides automated skill deduplication and quality improvement. It enables collective skill evolution and unified skill libraries across multiple agents and devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform skills library featuring 50 expert frameworks and 12 metaskills designed to orchestrate business and code journeys. It is compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io agents.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: A trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce providing adjudication for deals through natural-language mandates and escrow. It includes a master router, connector skills, and official protocol skills.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation alongside management slash commands.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Implements the Agent Skills open specification for Pydantic AI to provide type-safe support. It reduces token usage through progressive disclosure of skill metadata.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A suite of skills for extracting YouTube transcripts, captions, and timestamps without using yt-dlp. It supports video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other agents.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: A skill set that enables Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts via dynamic custom analytical lenses. It includes seven pre-built prisms and a constraint reporting feature to identify analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A workflow skill that converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running AI agents that provides structured memory and a three-level work model. It supports file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for task management.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: A literate programming skill that weaves code and documentation into.lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: A plugin for self-memory and replacement models that uses markdown files for cross-instance shared memory. It automates the capture of high-value decisions to facilitate fine-tuning replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Interoperable skills following the agentskills.io specification for interacting with the Oracle network and smart contracts. It supports CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds integration.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Official image generation skills for the FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It provides standardized prompting guidelines and API integration patterns for JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: A tool that converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It provides provenance via file:line citations or documentation URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It includes a Python SkilldockClient, a CLI, and commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: A skill for autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks. It features real-time progress tracking, checkpoints, and built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It uses a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: A skill for managing Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: A local-first workflow language implemented as a single Rust binary. It provides static auditing for cost, secrets, and types, and generates hash-chained execution receipts.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer intelligent skill retrieval system that uses hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model family and tracks quality scores in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial bug-hunting skill that uses three parallel subagents to analyze code for edge cases and exploitability. It is a read-only tool that integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io with MCP integration. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automatic registration of common skill directories.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: A skill that implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol and a Python goal engine.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent code simplification skill using a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It includes a risk-tiered triage system for safe code modifications.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing, searching, and one-click installation of skills. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification and features federated search.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: A CLI and MCP server that allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: A skill compatible with Hermes Agent and agentskills.io that automates payments for HTTP 402 responses. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols using USDC.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: A multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator that produces structured reports from global to street level. It includes quality gates and AI analysis for core conclusions and action suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes. It includes various CLI and desktop tools that are updated daily.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It features an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and provides configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This is a zero-install Windows desktop GUI that requires no admin rights. It features an integrated workflow engine for automated multi-step pipelines and includes an extensive toolset including TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project offers an automated Termux-based installation for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers like OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports configurable gateway mode.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level enforcement for sandboxing Hermes Agent via NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This project offers a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and identities. It provides hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents for fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysis within a financial trading context. It supports multiple LLM providers and utilizes a structured workflow for research debates and risk management approval.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration tool manages task assignment, execution review, and completion receipts through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, or REST API. It includes a memory browser and a relationship graph to monitor agent workflows and spend.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and mobile-friendly web dashboard for managing multiple coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It utilizes Docker sandboxing and git worktrees to ensure agent isolation.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This control room template employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for orchestrator-to-specialist delegation. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for local communication and tool handling, featuring a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for visualizing tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This project implements ACP-style delegation to route tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and output limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph via an MCP server to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. This tool supports Windows, macOS, and Linux and includes an auto-syncing local index.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool featuring a native Rust TUI for high-performance local monitoring of token usage and costs. It supports integrations for Hermes Agent alongside Claude Code, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer used to inspect system prompts, tool calls, and streaming responses from Hermes Agent. It allows users to compare adjacent requests for debugging and export portable HTML trace artifacts.
entries.bergside/typeui: Offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate applications. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for autonomous execution on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A community CLI tool for customizing the Hermes terminal UI with themes like cyberpunk or retro DOS. It uses YAML-based configuration to modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy for autonomous agents that provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates commerce through SOL and USDC payments and supports identity registration with @handles.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in CCC without OAuth or separate processes and includes MLOps tools for RL training and inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a visible UI for real-time supervision and includes session management and a research desk.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework used to create scoped Hermes Agents with per-folder configurations and skills. It enables seamless switching between default and scoped agents and supports project-local memories.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A setup featuring preconfigured skills and token-saving CLI workflows that can achieve 90-99% token savings. It includes 40+ skills for research, devops, and finance with automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: An automated installation tool that deploys a hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services in minutes. It provides three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A static linter for system prompts, tool descriptions, and AI agent configs that operates without API keys or LLM calls. It uses AST and regex to support JSON, YAML, Markdown, and.prompt files.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A migration tool designed to move OpenClaw configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats. It handles the migration of skills, memory archives, SOUL.md, and MEMORY.md.
entries.observeco/observeco: A self-healing observability tool for monitoring and auto-recovering multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a beta Hermes plugin that exports telemetry for tool calls and API requests.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users. It allows for the simultaneous management of Hermes Agent alongside other AI agents and CLI tools in a single application.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that unifies multiple CLI agents into one interface with a zero-configuration built-in engine. It distinguishes itself by automating the creation of office documents, including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel files.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web-based interface offers full parity with the Hermes CLI experience for both desktop and mobile browsers. It features a three-panel layout for workspace file browsing and utilizes SSH tunneling to provide secure remote access.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to simplify the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It provides a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: This dashboard focuses on multi-platform connectivity, offering unified configuration for channels like Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. It includes a file browser and web terminal while providing usage analytics and profile-scoped file management via local SQLite storage.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a 'Swarm Mode' with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task handling. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and dedicated managers for skills, memory, and MCP catalogs.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for real-time session data. It includes specialized native views for Kanban boards, cron jobs, and an embedded terminal for system repair and shell access.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension integrates Hermes Agent directly into the browser context for Chrome and Edge users. It can connect to local runtimes, Hermes Cloud, or remote gateways to provide a full-page web workspace.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime. It is specifically designed to support LaTeX and Markdown rendering for enhanced document visualization.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted dashboard features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines in real-time. It provides a control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and visualizes tool calls during streaming chat sessions.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS cockpit that tracks per-session quota burn-rates and costs across Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It allows users to inspect transcripts and browse images generated during agent sessions.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This macOS workspace is tailored for Orgo cloud computers and SSH hosts, offering one-click automated installation on fresh cloud VMs. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode that utilizes OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this terminal-based dashboard consolidates Hermes chat, sessions, and configuration into a TUI. It includes integrated kanban boards for diagnostics and an extensible Eikon avatar system for lifecycle management.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram, supporting dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication. It enables background agent spawning with support for up to five concurrent instances and streaming terminal chat.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This no-install Windows application requires no admin rights or Docker to run Hermes Agent locally via LM Studio. It includes a workflow engine for multi-step automation and 100 built-in tools for tasks like TTS and ComfyUI.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This self-hosted assistant features a glassmorphic web interface with real-time log streaming and task tracking. It provides management tools specifically for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A specialized monitoring dashboard that provides read-only inspection of environment variables and configuration. It allows users to track session costs in real-time and inspect the source code of active skills and conversation histories.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace uses isolated profiles to manage separate sessions, memory, and API keys. It features a chat-first design with tool approval cards and an integrated marketplace for discovering new skills and MCP servers.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents for complex tasks. It includes a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
